decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own page, sits at the core of the natural facial care offer and has been on the market for two years in a growing industry, and no shortfall against aspirations is visible, so the satisficing choice is to keep it.

The hyaluronic serum is a cheap, standard complement made in the firm's own small-batch production and shows no evident performance gap, so there is no trigger for search, though its low website prominence keeps the risk of withdrawal moderate.

The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and likely took the place of the withdrawn cleansing milk, so the small firm's modest slack is enough to carry it while its results are still uncertain, though as a newly listed product it remains somewhat expendable.
